modules.spectrogram-to-audio.reconstruct: Reconstructs a waveform with GL, extracts an 80-band Mel spectrum, restores it with NAFNet, and synthesizes with BigVGAN.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.griffin_lim: Griffin–Lim uses momentum acceleration (0.99) for faster phase-iteration convergence. Aoki initialization can be selected separately below.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.enter_image: Enter image duration and frequency range before predicting window length and dB.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.choose_the_: Choose the frequency axis to match the original image. The model predicts only window length and dynamic range.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.predict_win: Predict window length and dB range
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.predicts_fr: Predicts from current calibration; values remain editable.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.built_in_pa: Built-in parameter prediction works offline. Values remain editable after prediction.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.enter_a_dur: Enter a duration within 0–30 seconds and a frequency range from low to high. A logarithmic axis must start above 0 Hz.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.manual_para: Manual parameters are in use and will be retained for reconstruction.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.available_w: Available with either algorithm. Frame step defaults to one quarter of window length.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.cpu_inferen: CPU inference may be slow for longer audio. Select an existing GPU Python environment to accelerate restoration and vocoding.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.select_pyth: Select python.exe with GPU-enabled PyTorch installed. GPU becomes available after the check passes.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.gpu_environ: GPU environment reuses an existing installation. Models still require downloading; parameter prediction and GL run on CPU.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.duration_30: Duration ≤ 30 seconds, reconstruction area ≤ one million pixels, GL iterations 1–256. Image file ≤ 16 MB.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.use_the_des: Use the desktop app with task services running, or a signed-in web project.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.retains_the: Retains the audio's original time, frequency, and phase. Supports mono/stereo audio up to 30 seconds.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.click_top_l: Click top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left in order; {v0} / 4 selected
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.the_task_pe: The task perspective-corrects the four-point region. Without points, it uses the full image.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.import_a_gr: Import a grayscale spectrogram, or capture the screen in the desktop app.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.select_audi: Select audio to show an editable spectrogram automatically.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.after_selec: After selecting the image and corners, click Apply correction and draw.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.base_image_: Base-image settings changed. Reload the canvas; reloading clears its previous strokes.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.calibration: Calibration, corners, or strokes changed. This view still shows the selected saved task's original result. Start reconstruction again to use new settings.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.view_origin: View original parameter snapshot for this result
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.both_plots_: Both plots share the grayscale scale. The actual spectrum after inverse transformation may differ slightly from the drawn target.
Both plots share time/frequency ranges and dimensions, with separate relative grayscale scales.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.nonzero_sta: Nonzero start frequencies use band interpolation, with zeros in lower frequencies.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.use_the_sha: Use the shared playback bar below for the full audio or selection. Results include WAV, two PNGs, and parameter/source JSON.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.edits_magni: Edits magnitudes while preserving original phase, then generates audio by direct inverse transform. Unedited channels remain unchanged.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.after_gl_ex: After GL, extracts Mel spectra, restores them with NAFNet, and synthesizes with BigVGAN, adjusting output amplitude automatically.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.reconstruct: Reconstructs using image calibration, then synthesizes audio with BigVGAN.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.enter_time_: Enter time, frequency, and grayscale calibration from the image. Griffin–Lim estimates phase and reconstructs audio.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.no_tasks_ye: No tasks yet. Closing the module does not delete tasks.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.tasks_run_i: Tasks run in the background; switching modules is allowed. Keep the page open for browser tasks. Original image and parameter snapshots are fixed.

modules.spectrogram-to-audio.this_stroke: This stroke reached its limit. End the current stroke.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.drag_the_pl: Drag the plot's bottom-right corner to adjust height.
modules.spectrogram-to-audio.ctrl_wheel_: Ctrl + wheel to zoom · Shift + drag to pan · Ctrl + Z to undo · Ctrl + Shift + Z to redo
